name: Speech & Text Analytics
description: Transcription and classification layer that turns every recorded interaction into analyzable structure: topics, sentiment, emotion, compliance events, and machine-proposed dispositions across voice and text channels.
roleInCenter: Listening layer: converts raw interaction media into labeled, queryable events for QA automation, driver analysis, and risk spotting.

glossary.definition: Speech-to-text rendering of call audio, the base layer for all other analytes
Separation of who spoke when: agent, customer, or third party
Detection of mandated or forbidden phrases in transcripts and audio
Controlled taxonomy of conversation themes used to classify every interaction
Polarity scoring of customer expression; distinct from acoustic emotion detection
Acoustic-model classification of anger, frustration, laughter beyond word-level sentiment
Conversational structure metrics: agent-vs-customer airtime and silence spans
Model-proposed outcome label attached to interactions; feeds wrap audit and QA
Muting or masking PCI/HIPAA segments in audio and transcripts before analysis
Share of flagged interactions that reviewers confirm as true findings

failureModes.name: Transcript Fidelity Drift
failureModes.signal: Acoustic-heavy accents or crosstalk degrade WER silently; topic confidence falls
failureModes.mitigation: Sample human WER audit per channel; recalibration with domain lexicon

failureModes.name: Alert Fatigue
failureModes.signal: Reviewers clear alerts in bulk; precision unmeasured
failureModes.mitigation: Alert precision scorecard; thresholds tuned to reviewer feedback loop

failureModes.name: Sentiment Theater
failureModes.signal: Agent sentiment scores improve while customer measures worsen
failureModes.mitigation: Score customer side only for CX; ban agent-sentiment from QA scores by default

failureModes.name: Redaction Gaps
failureModes.signal: QA finds unredacted PCI in evaluation samples
failureModes.mitigation: Redaction verification as auto-QA artifact before analyst access

exchanges: Interaction records with queue and agent metadata
Unsolicited verbatims mined as VOC listening post
Driver topics without good answers become content backlog

scoringModel.name: Speech & Prosodic Telemetry Precision Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates streaming transcription fidelity, speaker diarization & talk-over dynamics, continuous valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) prosodic trajectory tracking, and compliance keyword spotter precision.

dimensions.name: Streaming Transcription & Speaker Diarization Fidelity
dimensions.description: Low word error rate on domain vocabulary and clean separation of customer and agent audio channels including overtalk spans
sampleCriteria: Word accuracy exceeds 92 percent across domain-specific product and billing terms
Dual-channel or neural diarization achieves <2 percent speaker attribution error
Talk-over, hold silence, and dead-air spans timestamped to 50-millisecond resolution

dimensions.name: Continuous VAD Prosodic & Acoustic Stress Tracking
dimensions.description: Real-time estimation of customer Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) trajectories and acoustic stress velocity independent of lexical sentiment
sampleCriteria: Customer valence-arousal-dominance vector updates every 250 milliseconds on [-1, 1]^3
Acoustic stress velocity spikes trigger supervisor or co-pilot empathy alerts within 1.5 seconds
CX affect scoring strictly isolates customer prosody from scripted agent politeness

dimensions.name: Compliance Keyword Spotting & Alert Precision
dimensions.description: Calibrated log-odds detection of mandatory disclosures, forbidden commitments, and escalation threats without inducing reviewer alert fatigue
sampleCriteria: Reviewer-confirmed alert precision exceeds 85 percent across compliance flags
Mandatory disclosure verification accounts for allowed lexical paraphrases and sequence order
High-risk churn and legal-threat utterances route immediately to targeted QA sampling

dimensions.name: Topic Classification & Auto-Disposition Concordance
dimensions.description: Coverage of primary contact drivers and concordance between model-proposed dispositions and human QA ground truth
sampleCriteria: Primary and secondary contact driver topics assigned on >95 percent of interactions
Auto-disposition agreement with QA-verified human wrap codes exceeds 88 percent
Emerging unindexed topic clusters automatically open KM and VOC discovery items

dimensions.name: Automated PCI & PII Redaction Hygiene
dimensions.description: Deterministic scrubbing of payment card digits, SSNs, and protected health data across both audio tracks and text transcripts prior to storage
sampleCriteria: 100 percent of PAN, CVV, and SSN spans masked in both stereo audio and transcript JSON
Redaction latency adds zero blocking delay to downstream post-call wrap workflows
Automated redaction audit artifact verified before analyst or LLM access

stateVariables.description: Continuous 3D Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) prosodic affect vector e(t) = (v(t), a(t), d(t)) in [-1, 1]^3 extracted from pitch, jitter, shimmer, and spectral energy
Instantaneous rate of change of customer arousal-minus-valence acoustic tension along the conversation trajectory
Sequential Bayesian log-odds evidence for mandatory disclosure completion or prohibited phrase occurrence up to time t
Instantaneous smoothed fraction of active speech frames exhibiting simultaneous agent-customer acoustic overlap (overtalk)
Continuous unannounced silence duration since last vocal activity across either speaker channel

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) Prosodic Trajectory SDE
differentialEquations.formula: de(t) = - Gamma_vad cdot (e(t) - e_base) dt + B_emp cdot u_agent(t) dt - kappa_over cdot r_over(t) cdot e_val dt + Sigma_vad cdot sqrt(1 - e(t)^2) dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Customer prosodic vector e(t) in [-1, 1]^3 mean-reverts at rate Gamma_vad, shifts toward positive valence under agent empathy control u_agent(t), degrades under talk-over collisions r_over(t), and remains bounded on [-1, 1]^3 via Jacobi diffusion

differentialEquations.name: Real-Time Acoustic Stress Velocity & Talk-Over Coupling
differentialEquations.formula: v_stress(t) = w_arousal cdot (da(t) cdot dt^-1) - w_valence cdot (dv(t) cdot dt^-1) + alpha_over cdot r_over(t), with dr_over(t) cdot dt^-1 = -lambda_over cdot r_over(t) + I_collision(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Acoustic stress velocity combines positive arousal acceleration and negative valence drop with exponentially smoothed speaker diarization talk-over collisions I_collision(t)

differentialEquations.name: Compliance Keyword Spotter Sequential Log-Odds Flow
differentialEquations.formula: dell_kw(t) = log(p_acoustic(y_t | H_phrase) cdot p_acoustic(y_t | H_null)^-1) dt
differentialEquations.interpretation: Continuous Wald Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT) integrates frame-level acoustic-lexical likelihood ratios into log-odds ell_kw(t) for low-latency compliance alerting

scaleInvariants: O(1) constant-memory streaming inference per audio channel via causal state-space recurrence at 20ms frame stride
Speaker-channel permutation equivariance: diarization separation and overtalk ratio r_over(t) remain invariant to gain scaling and codec bitrate adaptation
Bounded manifold invariance: Jacobi diffusion volatility sqrt(1 - e_i(t)^2) vanishes at boundaries plus or minus 1, guaranteeing e(t) stays strictly inside [-1, 1]^3 for all t >= 0
